data.description:
Brightpath was founded by HR leaders who believed recruitment could be faster and more human. Our consultants specialise by industry, so they understand the roles they fill.

Alongside hiring, we run payroll, compliance and training for companies that would rather focus on their customers than on paperwork.

items.question: How do you charge for recruitment?
items.answer: A success fee of 8.33% of annual CTC, payable only when a candidate joins.

items.question: Do you hire outside Hyderabad?
items.answer: Yes. We recruit across India and for Indian companies’ overseas teams.

items.question: Can you run payroll for a small team?
items.answer: Yes. Our payroll service starts at ten employees.

items.question: Are training programmes customised?
items.answer: Every programme is tailored after a needs assessment with your leaders.

This policy explains how we collect, use and protect the personal information you share with us through this website.

Information we collect

When you submit an enquiry we collect your name, email address, phone number and the details of your message.

How we use it

We use this information only to respond to your enquiry and to provide the services you request. We do not sell or share your information with third parties for marketing.

Contact

For any privacy question, contact us using the details on our Contact page.
